run_parallel_tasks: run a dictionary of thread-safe callables in parallel and return results keyed by name
run_background_tasks: run parallel tasks that collect both successful results and errors without failing on the first exception
map_parallel_fn: run a function over multiple argument collections in parallel using a thread pool executor
create_executor_context: create a thread pool executor context manager that cancels pending futures on error
stream_completed_futures: yield key and future tuples as parallel tasks complete using a thread pool
